title: What Multi-Generational Ship Governance Is
definition: Multi-Generational Ship Governance: laws and councils designed to last centuries in flight.
description:
Multi-Generational Ship Governance: laws and councils designed to last centuries in flight. This is Interstellar & Deep Space Futures at its most ambitious — civic modules research, governance propulsion engineering and succession law operations converging on a single goal: making charter hulls real.

Why it matters: Interstellar & Deep Space Futures will decide cultural continuity outcomes this century. Multi-Generational Ship Governance is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working charter hulls, the larger civic modules vision stalls, and with it, the governance propulsion systems that depend on it.

title: Readiness Estimator: Multi-Generational Ship Governance
definition: Estimates Multi-Generational Ship Governance readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Multi-Generational Ship Governance components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a charter hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Multi-Generational Ship Governance operating for a day.

title: Multi-Generational Ship Governance Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Multi-Generational Ship Governance: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Multi-Generational Ship Governance — laws and councils designed to last centuries in flight.

Phase 1 — Prove (civic modules): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (governance propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (succession law): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (cultural continuity): charter hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and generation ships-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
